summary: Iteration 3 verification of 4 new features (Rotate Access, Password Change, Assignee Filter, Weekly Digest). Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass (test_review_iter3.py). Frontend: full end-to-end script pass on desktop (1920x1080) + mobile (390x800) verifying all requested data-testids and behaviors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 194: overdue detection uses task['status'] not in ('Completed',) then compares parsed deadline < today (UTC now). Tasks with deadline='YYYY-MM-DD' are parsed as midnight UTC, which technically becomes 'overdue' on the same calendar day. Minor semantic quibble.

server.py line 196: completed_this_week compares string updated_at >= start (ISO string comparison). Works because both are ISO-8601 with the same offset (+00:00), but is fragile if any writer stores a differently-formatted timestamp. Prefer parsing.
server.py rotate_access does not require the member to be active nor logs an audit entry. Consider auditing rotations for compliance.
AdminDigest re-renders only totals from server; overdue/pending/completed arrays are returned but unused on the client — increases payload unnecessarily.
App.js grew past ~1500 lines; split Shell/Admin* components into separate files for maintainability.
Iteration 2 note still applies: CORS_ORIGINS fallback to '*' is incompatible with allow_credentials=True.
